BatshitTechnology.Showcases.ShowcaseDef.summary: A public information film: every device at work, then several of them exploding on cue.
BatshitTechnology.Showcases.ShowcaseDef.description:
A working Batshit Technology base, built on a fresh map with every project researched, toured scene by scene: a fuelled Batshittium Reactor powering a stocked Random Replicator, the Transmogrifier on a bill of rock chunks, a colonist in the Brain Squeezer, and the Artificer making bolts for a Batshit Ballista, which fires one 16-bolt volley, then meets a stampede of manhunting boomalopes from the east with one of 256.

Then the demonstrations. A lone Random Replicator and a lone Batshittium Reactor self-destruct in the far corners; the camera walks AnyRim, a small test town built for exactly this; a colonist throws an Ergonomic Singularity Grenade at a junk pile with a volunteer in it; a Tractor Bomb from the Tractor Barn finds a party of raiders; and two Tractor Bombs settle a junkyard full of them.

A scene this map cannot stage is left out. Colonists are moved clear of each blast. The volunteer was not consulted.

li.text: Living Better with Batshittium. A Batshit Technology public information film.
The future, delivered sooner, cheaper and funnier.
Two hundred and fifty thousand watts from a single unit of batshittium.
Your family will never know what's for supper, and neither will you.
Every rock on your land is a fortune waiting to be transmogrified.
A firm, reassuring squeeze for the overworked mind.
This is the home of tomorrow. Tomorrow has been moved forward.
The home of tomorrow must also look after itself.
The Artificer turns batshittium into bolts, quietly, around the clock.
Sixteen bolts, one volley, and a neighbourhood with very few complaints.
Note that the area now meets local lawn care standards.
Not every visitor calls ahead.
A herd of boomalopes has taken a keen interest in the family.
Two hundred fifty-six largely inaccurate—but highly explosive—Ballista bolts make for a firm, but neighborly, "No."
A few guests have stayed on. The Ballista will see them out.
The east has been cleared. The rain will see to the rest.
Your home is safe. The east will grow back.
Every Batshit device knows when to step aside.
Please step aside also.
The replicator has been retired with full honours.
A reactor, too, deserves a dignified retirement.
Please remain indoors. Any indoors will do.
Its warmth will be with us for some time.
Meanwhile, in the community.
Every home in AnyRim is a proving ground.
So is every neighbour.
The residents have been told everything they need to know.
AnyRim has never once complained in writing.
Comfort is the finest defence of all.
A valued member of the family has volunteered.
The family has declined to volunteer. The demonstration proceeds regardless.
Our volunteer reports feeling very supported.
Our volunteer has been comforted. Completely.
Everything is exactly where it belongs now.
The Tractor Barn builds it. The tractor finds the problem.
The Tractor Barn: a working farm building, in most respects.
This one was made earlier. The barn insists it was no trouble.
It has found a problem. It is very good at finding problems.
The tractor objects to bystanders. The bystander is reconsidering.
The tractor has settled in. It will not be moving again.
Some neighbours are making peace with their impending doom. This is normal.
Everything nearby is invited to the middle.
The invitation was not optional.
The problem is resolved.
Some problems call for a second opinion.
Both opinions have arrived, and they agree.
Please remain calm. The junkyard is being consolidated.
Consolidation is complete.
Two tractors are better than one.
The Future: Sooner. Cheaper. Funnier. And ludicrously dangerous.
